statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial management for known sick sinus syndrome
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated
The procedure code billed is CPT 93226
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and R42
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
